features.name: Serialize Simple Object
features.description: Serializes one scalar object to a binary payload.

features.name: Deserialize Simple Object
features.description: Deserializes one scalar object from a binary payload produced by the same library.

features.name: Serialize Nested Object
features.description: Serializes an order with a nested customer and address to a binary payload.

features.name: Deserialize Nested Object
features.description: Deserializes an order with a nested customer and address from a binary payload.

features.name: Serialize Collection
features.description: Serializes three ordered objects to a binary payload.

features.name: Deserialize Collection
features.description: Deserializes three ordered objects from a binary payload.

features.name: Enum Round Trip
features.description: Round-trips one enum member through the library's binary representation.
